Definition: from G2596 (intensive) and G332; to imprecate:--curse.
BiblicalUsage: Peter began to curse and to swear that he knew not the man, and the Jews bound themselves under a curse that they would neither eat nor drink till they had killed Paul.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe a curse is a terrible vow to make, and both passages show men using it to seal a wrong choice.
